name: figure-rig
description: Rig a static sculpt onto a Mixamo skeleton so it plays that skeleton's clips.

plugins.name: figure-rig
plugins.description: Skill: figure-rig. Marking views, a fit file, and a Blender script that binds a donor's Mixamo skeleton to a static sculpt in its own pose, pins props, and writes a light skinned GLB.
